comments.body:
MIT might be more recognised in the US, but if you plan on staying in europe, ETH will ve just as good. Both universities are among the best in the world, so if you would like to visit switzerland, go to ETH, if you prefer to stay in the US go to MIT. It is very much a personal decision rather than a question of quality. I believe the education in MIT and ETH will be the same quality. 

I am Swiss and could have gone to ETH, but decided to go to EPFL, which is the french-speaking pendant of ETH. While EPFL is a little bit less recognized than EPFL, it is a great opportunity to improve my french. I believe not to have any disadvantages because of studying at EPFL.
comments.author: __Reddidiot__
